Among the Sierra Nevada, California

By Albert Bierstadt
1868
What is it

A landscape that fills the room with light

Among the Sierra Nevada, California is one of the most celebrated landscapes of the American West: snow-capped peaks, a falling waterfall, a still lake and a herd of deer at the water’s edge, all lit by sunlight breaking through the clouds.

It is the first painting in Nostalgia’s collection, brought to your wall as a print made to stay with you.

The story

Painted in Rome, shown to the world

Albert Bierstadt created it in his Rome studio in the winter of 1867–68, four years after his journey to the Sierra Nevada. He showed it in Berlin and London before it reached American audiences, who took pride in its scale and in the natural splendour of their young nation.
